# CCOS Core — Intelligence Claims Policy (§8)

## Forbidden claims

```
CCOS is truly intelligent.
CCOS has artificial general intelligence.
CCOS understands like a human.
CCOS is conscious.
CCOS definitively replaces RAG.
CCOS necessarily learns from every interaction.
```

## Permitted language

```
CCOS is designed to provide persistent intelligence.
CCOS provides a cognitive architecture above language models.
CCOS aims to exceed the limits of passive RAG memory.
CCOS organizes experience, contradictions, provenance, and state changes.
CCOS is designed to enable auditable cognitive continuity.
CCOS must experimentally demonstrate its advantages over RAG architectures.
```

## Rule

The word **"intelligence" must always be connected to measurable criteria**
(§8): the operational definition in §7 and the metrics in
docs/benchmarks/METRICS.md. Any README, paper, release note or benchmark
publication must cite the scenario, sample count, method, model identity,
configuration and date. Publication of benchmark results requires the
explicit approval of ZEKRITI Tarek (§40).

## What this project tries to demonstrate (§51)

CCOS remembers in a structured way, distinguishes present from past, manages
contradictions, revises its state, invalidates obsolete knowledge, connects
decisions to outcomes, reuses experience, maintains continuity, and explains
its own state evolution. The scientific objective is **falsifiability**
(H1–H7, docs/research/CCOS_COGNITIVE_HYPOTHESES.md).
